commit.message:
Align owner telephone validation to exactly 10 digits (#393)

* Align owner telephone validation to 10 digits

* Improve owner telephone validation test cases

Replace loop-based POST and PUT validation tests with JUnit parameterized tests using @ParameterizedTest and @ValueSource.

Add response assertions to verify MethodArgumentNotValidException and confirm that the telephone field caused the validation failure.
